info.name: Dailzo
info.description:
Dailzo food & grocery delivery platform API — customer storefront, restaurant/grocery vendor, delivery partner, and admin surfaces. Regenerated from the live route table in main.go + api/openapi.yaml (previous collection targeted a defunct localhost:3000/api/* legacy server and predates the v1 API entirely).

Set `host`/`base_url` if your server isn't on localhost:2193. Run Auth > Login (or Send OTP + Verify OTP), copy the returned `token` into the collection variable, and every other request authenticates automatically via the collection-level Bearer auth.

request.description: user_type must be one of customer, restaurant, grocery, delivery_partner (server rejects anything else, e.g. admin, as of the signup role-whitelist fix).

Mobile is find-or-create: a brand-new number silently registers a customer account. Response includes user_id, needed for Verify OTP. For an existing account you can instead send {"email": "..."}, which requires the account to already exist.

OTP is logged to the server console by utils.SendOTPSMS (no real SMS gateway configured) or emailed for real via SMTP if SMTP_* env vars are set. On success returns a JWT — paste it into the collection's `token` variable.

item.name: Storefront - Catalog
item.description: Public browse endpoints, no auth required.

request.description: Free-form body (no fixed schema server-side) — cart contents/pricing are computed from the user's server-side cart, not from this body.
outlet_id (or restaurant_id) scopes the list to one outlet — omit to see all outlets your token has read access to.
status is validated against the shared allow-list: pending, confirmed, preparing, ready, picked_up, in_transit, delivered, cancelled.
Legacy manual assignment — for the delivery partner's own self-serve flow use Delivery > Claim Available Order instead.

request.description: Only an allow-listed field set is accepted: name, description, price, category, image_url, is_active, stock_quantity, expiry_date, is_promo, promo_price, auto_discount_pct.
Free-form JSON — persisted as-is under the caller's user_id; only user_type is read out explicitly server-side.
Free-form JSON, passed straight through to storage.

request.description: Only the mock gateway is registered server-side (no real HyperPay/PayTabs creds configured). Mock convention: amount ending .05 forces a 3DS challenge, .09 forces a failure, anything else captures clean.
